notes.title: FROG 'N' ROLL ENDLESS UPDATE!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Endless mode!
[*] Added an option to restart gamemode
[*] Added option to retry on death or victory
[*] Fixed a bug where boss achievements wouldn't unlock for some NG+ bosses
[/list]

Thanks for playing Frog 'n' Roll! I tried to get a leaderboard set up for the endless mode, but honestly, my brain is just too small :) So unless I figure that out later down the line this will very likely be the last update for Frog 'n' Roll outside of any bug fixes. I hope you enjoy the game and thank you for supporting me. 

I started this game with the goal of releasing a steam game in a set time frame and because of that I want anyone that's reading this to know that I can do better and I hope you stick around to find that out!! See you in like a year or two when I finish my next game lol

Thanks again!!

notes.title: Little changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] a little bit of rebalancing to the NG+ waves
[*] if an enemy dies off screen money will spawn on the player
[*] thick, laser and multi now shoot below the player so you can see a little better
[*] minor adjustments to some waves
[/list]

notes.title: Frog 'n' Roll - RELAUNCH UPDATE!
notes.content:
[b]SKIP THIS PART AND READ BELOW FOR GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]
Hi! Thanks for playing Frog 'n' Roll! I'm pushing a major update to make myself feel better about y'all having paid money for the game! The game should now be a lot more replayable with a decent amount of added content! I have plans of other things I want to add to the game to make it even better but for now I think I'll leave the game as it is and work on bigger projects! Frog 'n' Roll was only ever meant to be a small little game but if the game picks up steam and reaches a wider audience I'll come back and add more stuff to the game! Thank you again for playing my game, it means the world to me <3

[b]GAMEPLAY ADDITIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 unique New Game+ playthroughs have been added with different waves of enemies for each as well as more unique and difficult boss fights
[*] Added 2 new bosses and made the secret boss actually secret
[*] 5 new items (Check gameplay changes)
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed a bug where opening the steam overlay would make the game freak out
[/list]

[b]QOL CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now increase AND decrease volume instead of having to wrap back to 0
[*] Volume increases and decreases by 1 instead of 10 now (you can still press the volume rather than move left and right to increase by 10)
[*] Changed colours of certain enemies and items for visual clarity
[*] particles now fade away faster for visual clarity
[*] added the controls of the game to the first level (this shows keyboard and controller controls depending on which you're using)
[*] Items now show text telling you what that item/upgrade does when you purchase them.
[*] ENEMIES NO LONGER WRAP AROUND THE SCREEN AND DEAL STUPID ANNOYING DAMAGE!!!
[/list]

(There's likely other minor changes I'm forgetting)

[b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] made the base game a bit easier to account for New Game+
[*] completely reworked how items and the shop work.
[*] Items in the current shop no longer go up in price after you purchase one
[*] added 5 additional items to adjust for the removal of the item combo system
[*] adjusted the speed of certain enemies to increase difficulty and give the "Speed" item a purpose
[*] "Fumes" item now moves around the screen slowly rather than being stationary
[*] "Puddle" now acts more like a trail you leave behind your frog as you move
[*] Adjusted some enemy behaviours
[/list]

[b]MINOR CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the background on the opening screen
[*] Added steam stats for enemies/bosses killed, deaths and won runs!
[*] 4 new achievements!
[/list]
